To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• The use of a high level programming model to specify and optimize the application software is a good way to hide the HW/SW refinement of a heterogeneous multiprocessor SoC.

(1) the programming model must be able to hide the hardware and software refinement of the platform; (2) the hardware refinement must be done at the lowest possible level; (3) the software refinement must be done as close as possible to the final platform.
the use of a high level programming model is a key factor for a fast and efficient design of heterogeneous MP-SoCs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of programming models for heterogeneous MPSoC that will allow to hide both hardware and software refinement.
the design of a new parallel programming model that can be used for the specification of the software for heterogeneous MPSoC.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no one programming model that can be applied to all MPSoC architectures.
the parallel programming model is a key enabler to achieve a high productivity and a high performance in the design of MPSoC.
the use of parallel programming models in the context of MPSoC design is an essential and promising research area that will have a major impact on the future of MPSoC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the programming models and interfaces are not the bottleneck for MPSoC design, but the lack of a common methodology for their specification and the lack of a methodology for the integration of the programming models in the HW/SW co-design flow.
the use of parallel programming models for heterogeneous MPSoC is a promising approach for the design of future embedded systems.
we are developing a programming model for MPSoC design that allows us to specify a system in an abstract way and that can be refined in different abstraction levels.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of heterogeneous multi-processor platforms is a very challenging task.
the design of a new programming model for MPSoCs should not start from scratch.
the programming model must be defined early in the design process and that the programming model should be defined in the context of the target architecture.
